mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY biz01_provide_company collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS contact_id , biz01_provide_company AS contact_name FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_company IS NOT NULL AND upper(biz01_provide_company) like upper(#{searchText}) GROUP BY biz01_provide_company

SELECT crm09_contact_id AS contact_id , crm09_contact_nm AS contact_name , crm09_item_type_cd AS item_type_code , f_cdnm('CrmItemTypeCode', crm09_item_type_cd, crm09_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS item_type_name , crm09_contact_emp_nm AS contact_emp_name , crm09_contact_org_nm AS contact_org_name , crm09_contact_title AS contact_title , crm09_contact_pos AS contact_pos , crm09_contact_tel_no AS contact_tel_no , crm09_contact_mobile_no AS contact_mobile_no , crm09_contact_email_addr AS contact_email_addr , crm09_contact_dt::date AS contact_date , crm09_person_id AS person_id , crm09_company_id AS company_id , crm09_major_issues AS major_issues , crm09_note AS note , (SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN crm14_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(crm14_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(crm14_org_id, f_today()) END FROM crm14_share_default WHERE crm14_contact_id = crm09_contact_id ORDER BY crm14_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM crm14_share_default WHERE crm14_contact_id = crm09_contact_id) AS share_info FROM crm09_contact WHERE crm09_contact_id = #{contactId} AND crm09_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm09_contact ( crm09_contact_id, crm09_contact_nm, crm09_item_type_cd, crm09_contact_emp_nm, crm09_contact_org_nm , crm09_contact_title, crm09_contact_pos, crm09_contact_tel_no, crm09_contact_mobile_no, crm09_contact_email_addr , crm09_contact_dt, crm09_person_id, crm09_company_id, crm09_major_issues, crm09_note ) VALUES( #{contactId}, #{req.contactName}, #{req.itemTypeCode}, #{req.contactEmpName}, #{req.contactOrgName} , #{req.contactTitle}, #{req.contactPos}, #{req.contactTelNo}, #{req.contactMobileNo}, #{req.contactEmailAddr} , f_today(), #{personId}, #{companyId}, #{req.majorIssues}, #{req.note} )
